extract_row_to_polars_dataframe: extract a single row from a PyArrow table and return it as a Polars DataFrame using PolarsArrowExtractor
extract_column_to_polars_series: extract a single column from a PyArrow table and return it as a Polars Series using PolarsArrowExtractor
extract_batch_to_polars_dataframe: extract a full batch from a PyArrow table and return it as a Polars DataFrame using PolarsArrowExtractor
decode_polars_row_with_features: decode a Polars DataFrame row using HuggingFace Features with PolarsFeaturesDecoder to transform nested column values
format_batch_with_polars_formatter: format a PyArrow table batch into a decoded Polars DataFrame using PolarsFormatter with optional Features
